title: The OlmoEarth Platform: Geospatial inference at planetary scale
summary: OlmoEarth is a geospatial inference platform by AI2 that enables planetary-scale analysis by combining a large-scale geospatial data infrastructure with a family of vision-language models. It supports tasks like flood detection, land cover classification, and disaster response through a flexible API and open-source tools.
highlights: OlmoEarth provides a unified platform for geospatial inference at planetary scale.
It integrates a massive geospatial data pipeline with vision-language models.
The platform supports diverse applications including flood detection and land cover mapping.
Open-source tools and APIs enable researchers to build custom geospatial AI solutions.
